description:
## Why

PKIX-ng0x decomposition, child 1 of 5. Foundation: the
`AttributeCertificate` type currently wraps `Vec<u8>` with no parsing.
Without a real ASN.1 type, none of the later children can be built.

## What

1. Define the RFC 5755 §4.1 ASN.1 types using `der` derives:
   - `AttributeCertificate ::= SEQUENCE { acinfo, signatureAlgorithm,
      signature }`
   - `AttributeCertificateInfo ::= SEQUENCE { version, holder, issuer,
      signature, serialNumber, attrCertValidityPeriod, attributes,
      issuerUniqueID OPTIONAL, extensions OPTIONAL }`
   - `Holder`, `V2Form`, `IssuerSerial`, `ObjectDigestInfo`,
      `AttCertValidityPeriod`, `Attribute`, etc. (most are
      reusable from `x509-cert` where possible).
2. Implement `Decode` + `Encode` for the top-level type via derives.
3. Replace the current `Vec<u8>` wrapper inside `AttributeCertificate`
   in `pkix-ac/src/lib.rs` with the new typed inner.
4. Public API: `AttributeCertificate::parse_der(bytes)` and `.to_der()`.

## Tests

- [ ] Round-trip oracle: a known-good AC DER (sourced externally — see
      below) is parsed, then re-encoded, then byte-equal to the input.
      External oracle is the original encoder (openssl `cms` /
      `attr-cert` tooling or pyca/cryptography), NOT pkix-ac itself.
- [ ] Negative oracle: malformed DER returns `Err`, never panics.
- [ ] Property: each Holder shape (baseCertificateID, entityName,
      objectDigestInfo) parses if present in the input.

## External AC test vector sourcing

Real-world ACs are scarce. Options:
1. **pyca/cryptography**: `tests/x509/scripts/` may have an
   attribute-cert generator. Verify before relying on it.
2. **OpenSSL**: `openssl cms -aa` or the `cmsutil` family in newer
   OpenSSL builds may produce ACs.
3. **Bouncy Castle**: Java test suite ships AC vectors at known paths.

The bead implementer must pick one source and commit the resulting DER
plus a regenerate script.

## Acceptance

- [ ] AttributeCertificate parses RFC 5755 §4.1 SEQUENCE.
- [ ] Round-trip succeeds against at least one real-world DER.
- [ ] Tests document the external oracle.
- [ ] No new runtime deps.
title: pkix-ac: RFC 5755 §4.1 AttributeCertificate ASN.1 parser + round-trip
